document.title: MAREA instrument and dashboard token specification (day / sunlight / night)

implementation.statement: PROPOSED ONLY. No value in this file is applied to src/, public/ or the live website. Implementation belongs to MC-06+ after review.

document.instrumentRoleNaming: The instrument role sets (instrument-day / instrument-sunlight / instrument-night) use role-based names only, never colour names (no --blue-500). The web-light block below is a read-only compatibility mapping of the existing src/styles.scss token names and is the only place where legacy colour-named keys appear; renaming live site tokens is out of MC-04 scope and would be an MC-06 migration decision.
notes: Values marked as refined in COLOUR-SYSTEM.md were tightened from the brief's §5.3 starting values so the proposed instrument palettes meet the brief's own stricter internal targets on every surface they are actually used on.
Every fg/bg pair used by the roles is measured; no ratio in this file is claimed without the evidence JSON.
Night mode contains no #000000 canvas and no #ffffff text (halation rule §5.8).

roles.canvas: Application background / page surface of the instrument view.
roles.surface: Panel that holds data; never a decorative card.
roles.surfaceRaised: Tinted panel or grouped sub-surface; boundary needs an explicit label, not colour alone.
roles.overlayScrim: Dimming layer behind overlays. No data is ever placed on the scrim; overlay content sits on an opaque surface.
roles.textPrimary: Primary text, headings, primary numeric readouts when read as text.
roles.textMeta: Provenance, age, units of the metadata strip.
roles.textOnAccent: Text/icons placed on a filled action or state surface.
roles.chartLine: Trend/scales/trend lines: required to understand content.
roles.chartGrid: Grid, ticks and axis rules; supporting cue, never the only encoding.
roles.stateCritical: Alarm level 4 text/icon; always paired with shape + cause + action.
roles.stateWarning: Caution/warning levels 2–3 text/icon; always paired with triangle + label.
roles.stateSafe: Normal/safe state text/icon; describes a signal, never a guarantee about the vessel.
roles.stateStale: Stale/offline/no-data text/icon; always paired with age counter and pattern.
roles.stateInfo: Advisory/info text/icon; neutral ink, not a hue accent.
roles.action: Interactive text, links and filled action surfaces.
roles.focusRing: Keyboard focus indicator drawn on canvas/surface/raised.
roles.focusRingOnFill: Focus indicator drawn inside a filled action/state control (inverse of focusRing).
roles.disabled: Disabled control text/icon; remains perceivable, never invisible.

web-light.appliesTo: Corporate website, docs, product pages (existing light theme; stays light — brief §5.4).
web-light.roleNaming: Legacy src/styles.scss token names retained verbatim for compatibility mapping only (navy2, sea, seaStrong, seaButton, badge*Bg, themeColor, line). This block is NOT part of the proposed instrument vocabulary and is not an approval of those names.
web-light.sourceOfValues: src/styles.scss (read-only reference, values not changed by MC-04)

mappingToTokenVocabulary.themeColor: index.html theme-color (not a token today — finding F-3)

notes: Measured only; no CSS is changed by MC-04.

Existing site values stay AA-gated. The stricter internal targets are recorded, not enforced, for this baseline because they describe the future instrument palette; the misses are the documented findings F-1…F-6.

instrument-day.appliesTo: App/NAV/DISPLAY daytime, bridge daylight (software only; not the corporate website).

refinementsFromBrief.reason: brief §5.5 internal target for normal text is ≥5:1; --muted measures 4.83:1 on the day canvas --mist and 4.71:1 on --sky, so a deeper secondary ink is required on instrument surfaces
meta/provenance is normal-size text; must meet ≥5:1 on canvas, surface and raised surface
stale values must stay readable; brief value measures 4.87:1 on --mist and 4.74:1 on --sky, below the ≥5:1 internal target

proposes a compliant focus indicator (6.92:1 / 6.50:1 / 6.34:1 on the day surfaces, ≥4.5:1 internal focus target). This does NOT resolve F-1: the live site still uses #8fd2f5 at 1.65:1 and nothing is applied; F-1 remains OPEN until MC-06 implements and verifies the change.
a focus indicator must be distinguishable against the filled control too; white measures 5.63:1 on the action fill and 7.18:1 on the critical fill

instrument-sunlight.appliesTo: Same surfaces under high ambient light and glare (hardware validation BLOCKED — no display exists).
notes: Higher luminance canvas and deeper ink than day; chroma reliance reduced.
No WCAG equivalent for glare; hardware validation BLOCKED and not claimed.
No pure black canvas and no pure white text (halation rule §5.8).
Alert colours keep a perceivable floor; no hue shift that turns a warning into a calm colour.
Dimming must have a floor: night values are not derived by inverting the day palette.

stateEncoding.rule: Colour never carries meaning alone (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1). Remove colour and every state must remain unambiguous (greyscale test).

states.extraCue: steady; optional ≤1 Hz pulse only if reduced-motion allows
persistent banner; audible optional, never sole
persistent until acknowledged; acknowledgement never removes the condition
age counter in tabular digits; value attenuated but readable
never a zero, never a frozen last value

sizes.numericPrimary: 48–72 px equivalent (≈18–24 mm at 0.6–0.9 m, PROPOSED, hardware BLOCKED)
sizes.label: 12–14 px equivalent
sizes.touchTarget: ≥24×24 CSS px (AA floor), 44×44 internal wet/glove target

notes: Brief §7.8 constraints: control radii 2–4 px, surfaces 4–8 px, pills only for status chips with text, one elevation for overlays only, no gradients in any token.
No flashing above 3 Hz (WCAG 2.3.1). Alert pulse ≤1 Hz only when prefers-reduced-motion does not ask to reduce. Night mode reduces or disables pulsing.

webTokenMapping.statement: Instrument roles map onto existing web token vocabulary where the roles coincide; the browser website remains light and unchanged.

pairs.relationship: instrument day canvas is --mist, not --paper: the instrument is a surface, not a page
proposes a compliant replacement focus indicator; F-1 remains OPEN for the live site until MC-06 implements and verifies it (MC-04 applies nothing)
